docking.center_note: co-crystallised antagonist SB-366791 (residue ZEI, chain A, seqnum 1202) centroid, computed directly from the PDB file. dock._ligand_center returns the WRONG centre here ([92.49, 85.19, 76.00] = POV A 1201 phospholipid, ~18.4 A from the pocket) because POV is not in dock._LIPIDS and is larger than the drug (134 vs 34 atoms).
docking.correction_note: Pipeline run_docking.py reported no_pdb_found: find_pdb_for_uniprot accepts only X-ray structures <3.0 A, and all TRPV1 structures are cryo-EM. 8GFA is the best-resolution human TRPV1 structure (2.29 A) with an antagonist in the vanilloid pocket. 8GFA is the antagonist-bound closed conformation, which may favour antagonists over agonists; scores compare pocket fit only, never analgesic potency.
